title: Zen and the Art of Motorcycle Maintenance
author: Robert M. Pirsig
summary: A father and son ride a motorcycle across America while the narrator explores what quality means, drawing on the memory of his earlier self, Phaedrus.
readIf: you like philosophy mixed with a road trip and are patient with abstract ideas.
skipIf: you want a straightforward travel memoir or a how-to for motorcycles.
